mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% over the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the last quarter signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased over the previous quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the last month signals inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreased and CPIAUCSL increased over the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the last month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 2% in the previous month.
